disposition_reason: Laboratory processing experiment measuring Pb, Cd, Cu and Zn in milk and in cream, skim milk, butter, buttermilk, soft cheese and whey made from it, with percent transfer.

study.method: microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion and ICP-OES (Perkin Elmer Optima 4000 DV)
study.qa: spike recoveries 89.9-114.5% at 0.01, 0.1 and 1 mg/kg in each matrix (Table 5); no CRM
